notes: HERO ANCHOR. The Baie Dore Casino on Ndogo Beach, Rockay City, the night a Category 5 makes landfall. 4-building hero site (hero rule 2-4): (1) BAIE DORE CASINO - main mass; gaming floor at grade, the Cage on story 1, the vault two stories BELOW sea level; per-story stairs + freight lift + a service stair (no through-stairs - Phase 1 finding: multi-story switchbacks orphan intermediate floors). (2) VALET PARKING DECK - insertion; deck-0 lobby link + deck-1 sniper/overwatch overlook onto the crescent. (3) BOARDWALK PIER PAVILION - extraction; airboat berth, only holds during the eye. (4) BACK-OF-HOUSE SERVICE BLOCK - staff route + the storm-shutter override room (soft breach to the Cage). Signature system = a STORM CLOCK that escalates independent of the alarm (advisory, owned by the production game per the Authority Statement; encoded as dispatch dynamic_events): power fails -> lights flip to emergency red; surge 1 floods the sub-basement vault approach (reroute via freight lift); surge 2 floods the gaming floor (slot banks become waist-deep cover, movement slows, heavy bags slow you more); the EYE opens the single airboat extraction window. Civilian->dangerous flip (Crime Boss style): insert in civilian mode inside the mandatory-evacuation crowd; the crowd is your cover until a weapon fires, the drill starts, or the shutters trip. Built to exploit assets already in-repo: lux presets mission_goes_hot / ps1_storm_night / heavy_rain for the escalating storm lighting, skymint apocalypse|sinister panoramas for the sky, Lot walkable site + Laser Tag nav/readiness on the flooding floor plates. Introduces a new theme 'rockay' (coastal art-deco + neon + storm dressing): Pixelcoat profiles/themes/rockay.json (11 curated materials) + a rockay style on all 48 Zoo species. The theme resolves end to end; textures need one Pixelcoat theme-library run + Blender for the Zoo kit build. Pacing: hero traversal ~2.5-3.5 min; the 12-20 min mission length is owned downstream by the vault drill + the surge timers, not traversal.
